      "formal_name": "inhomogeneousCochains.d",
      "informal_name": "Coboundary map for inhomogeneous cochains",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "{k G : Type u} →\n  [inst : CommRing k] →\n    [inst_1 : Monoid G] →\n      (A : Rep k G) → (n : ℕ) → ModuleCat.of k ((Fin n → G) → ↑A.V) ⟶ ModuleCat.of k ((Fin (n + 1) → G) → ↑A.V)",
      "informal_description": "Let $G$ be a monoid, $k$ a commutative ring, and $A$ a representation of $G$ over $k$. The coboundary map $d$ is a $k$-linear map from the module of $n$-cochains (functions $f: G^n \\to A$) to the module of $(n+1)$-cochains. For an $n$-cochain $f$, its image $d(f)$ is an $(n+1)$-cochain defined on a tuple $(g_0, \\dots, g_n) \\in G^{n+1}$ by the formula:\\n$$ (d f)(g_0, \\dots, g_n) = g_0 \\cdot f(g_1, \\dots, g_n) + \\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} (-1)^{i+1} f(g_0, \\dots, g_i g_{i+1}, \\dots, g_n) + (-1)^{n+1} f(g_0, \\dots, g_{n-1}) $$",
      "path": "Mathlib.RepresentationTheory.Homological.GroupCohomology.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_comp_coeff",
      "informal_name": "Composition of Hasse Derivatives and Binomial Coefficients in Laurent Series",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k l : ℕ)\n  (f : LaurentSeries V) (n : ℤ),\n  ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R l) f)).coeff n =\n    ((k + l).choose k • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R (k + l)) f).coeff n",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $k, l$ and Laurent series $f$ with coefficients in an $R$-module $V$, the composition of the $k$-th and $l$-th Hasse derivatives satisfies $\\text{hasseDeriv}_k(\\text{hasseDeriv}_l f) = \\binom{k + l}{k} \\cdot \\text{hasseDeriv}_{k + l} f$. Specifically, for any integer exponent $n$, the coefficient of $n$ in the composed derivative equals $\\binom{k + l}{k}$ multiplied by the coefficient of $n$ in the $(k + l)$-th Hasse derivative of $f$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.LaurentSeries"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Rep.standardComplex.d",
      "informal_name": "Differential in the standard complex",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "(k : Type u) → [inst : CommRing k] → (G : Type u) → (n : ℕ) → ((Fin (n + 1) → G) →₀ k) →ₗ[k] (Fin n → G) →₀ k",
      "informal_description": "The $ k $-linear map $ d_n $ that defines the boundary operator in the standard chain complex, mapping $ k $-linear combinations of functions $ \\mathrm{Fin}(n+1) \\to G $ to $ k $-linear combinations of functions $ \\mathrm{Fin}(n) \\to G $, where $ G $ is a type and $ k $ is a commutative ring.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RepresentationTheory.Homological.Resolution"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "HVertexOperator.coeff_comp",
      "informal_name": "Composition of H-Vertex Operators",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {Γ : Type u_5} {Γ' : Type u_6} [inst : PartialOrder Γ] [inst_1 : PartialOrder Γ'] {R : Type u_7} [inst_2 : CommRing R]\n  {U : Type u_8} {V : Type u_9} {W : Type u_10} [inst_3 : AddCommGroup U] [inst_4 : Module R U]\n  [inst_5 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_6 : Module R V] [inst_7 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_8 : Module R W]\n  (A : HVertexOperator Γ R V W) (B : HVertexOperator Γ' R U V) (g : Lex (Γ' × Γ)),\n  HVertexOperator.coeff (A.comp B) g = HVertexOperator.coeff A (ofLex g).2 ∘ₗ HVertexOperator.coeff...",
      "informal_description": "For H-vertex operators $ A: V\\llbracket \\Gamma \\rrbracket \\to W\\llbracket \\Gamma \\rrbracket $ and $ B: U\\llbracket \\Gamma' \\rrbracket \\to V\\llbracket \\Gamma' \\rrbracket $, the coefficient of their composition $ A \\circ B $ at position $ g \\in \\Gamma' \\times_\\ell \\Gamma $ equals the composition of $ A $'s coefficient at $ (\\mathrm{ofLex}\\, g)_2 $ with $ B $'s coefficient at $ (\\mathrm{ofLex}\\, g)_1 $, i.e., $ (A \\circ B)_g = A_{(\\mathrm{ofLex}\\, g)_2} \\circ B_{(\\mathrm{ofLex}\\, g)_1} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Vertex.HVertexOperator"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "HVertexOperator.coeff_of_coeff",
      "informal_name": "Equality of Coefficients in Vertex Operator Construction",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder Γ] {R : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [inst_1 : CommRing R]\n  [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module R V] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : Module R W] (f : Γ → V →ₗ[R] W)\n  (hf : ∀ (x : V), (Function.support fun g => (f g) x).IsPWO), HVertexOperator.coeff (HVertexOperator.of_coeff f hf) = f",
      "informal_description": "For a commutative ring $ R $, a partially ordered type $ \\Gamma $, $ R $-modules $ V $ and $ W $, and a family of $ R $-linear maps $ f: \\Gamma \\to V \\to W $ such that for every $ x \\in V $, the support of the function $ \\gamma \\mapsto f_\\gamma(x) $ is partially well-ordered under $ \\leq $, the coefficients of the vertex operator constructed from $ f $ and this support condition are equal to the original family $ f $. items.informal_name: Composition of Hasse Derivatives and Binomial Coefficients in Laurent Series
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k l : ℕ)
  (f : LaurentSeries V) (n : ℤ),
  ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R l) f)).coeff n =
    ((k + l).choose k • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R (k + l)) f).coeff n
items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $k, l$ and Laurent series $f$ with coefficients in an $R$-module $V$, the composition of the $k$-th and $l$-th Hasse derivatives satisfies $\text{hasseDeriv}_k(\text{hasseDeriv}_l f) = \binom{k + l}{k} \cdot \text{hasseDeriv}_{k + l} f$. Specifically, for any integer exponent $n$, the coefficient of $n$ in the composed derivative equals $\binom{k + l}{k}$ multiplied by the coefficient of $n$ in the $(k + l)$-th Hasse derivative of $f$.

  HVertexOperator.coeff (A.comp B) g = HVertexOperator.coeff A (ofLex g).2 ∘ₗ HVertexOperator.coeff...
items.informal_description: For H-vertex operators $ A: V\llbracket \Gamma \rrbracket \to W\llbracket \Gamma \rrbracket $ and $ B: U\llbracket \Gamma' \rrbracket \to V\llbracket \Gamma' \rrbracket $, the coefficient of their composition $ A \circ B $ at position $ g \in \Gamma' \times_\ell \Gamma $ equals the composition of $ A $'s coefficient at $ (\mathrm{ofLex}\, g)_2 $ with $ B $'s coefficient at $ (\mathrm{ofLex}\, g)_1 $, i.e., $ (A \circ B)_g = A_{(\mathrm{ofLex}\, g)_2} \circ B_{(\mathrm{ofLex}\, g)_1} $.

items.type:
∀ {Γ : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder Γ] {R : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [inst_1 : CommRing R]
  [inst_2 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_3 : Module R V] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup W] [inst_5 : Module R W] (f : Γ → V →ₗ[R] W)
  (hf : ∀ (x : V), (Function.support fun g => (f g) x).IsPWO), HVertexOperator.coeff (HVertexOperator.of_coeff f hf) = f
items.informal_description: For a commutative ring $ R $, a partially ordered type $ \Gamma $, $ R $-modules $ V $ and $ W $, and a family of $ R $-linear maps $ f: \Gamma \to V \to W $ such that for every $ x \in V $, the support of the function $ \gamma \mapsto f_\gamma(x) $ is partially well-ordered under $ \leq $, the coefficients of the vertex operator constructed from $ f $ and this support condition are equal to the original family $ f $. This establishes that the $ \text{coeff} $ attribute of the constructed vertex operator recovers the input coefficient functions.
